title: Steve Jobs' original vision for iOS web apps, WWDC 2007
summary: A two-minute clip of Steve Jobs at WWDC 2007 introducing the plan for iPhone third-party apps as web apps built on Safari and Ajax. It shows the original vision before the native SDK and App Store.
why: HN cites it in platform-power and PWA debates as proof that Apple originally wanted the future of apps to be on the web.

quote.text: Steve Jobs wanted no third-party native code running on the iPhone, only web apps that connect to third-party services.[1][2]
